notes: Configured as nosniff in public/_headers and dist/_headers.
Restricts camera, microphone, geolocation, usb, payment, browsing-topics, accelerometer, gyroscope, and magnetometer.
Configured max-age 31536000 without includeSubDomains to reduce deployment risk.
Report-only policy avoids breaking production while validating script/connect/style allowances.
Observed on production from Cloudflare; not repository-controlled.
